name: rfp-agent
description: RFP Agent builds a reusable company knowledge base from your existing Q&A (including Word, Excel, Confluence or Notion exports) and uses it to draft evidence-backed answers to RFPs and security questionnaires in Word or Excel. Unsupported questions stay blank and go to a simple SME review workbook; approved answers update the KB. Runs locally; your data stays on your computer.
